endpoints.title: Calculate Score (Synchronous)
endpoints.summary: Reads the account ABC classification and returns a CustomScore (A=90, B=70, C=50). SSC V2 waits for the response and persists the field automatically — no write-back call needed.
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open Settings → Extensibility → AutoFlows.
Create a new AutoFlow on the Account business object.
Set the trigger to "On Save" and the type to Synchronous.
Add an action of type "Call External Service / Webhook".
Paste this endpoint's full URL (shown above) as the target.
Map the account record as the request body (currentImage).
Ensure a custom field "CustomScore" exists on the Account (Extensibility → Custom Fields).
Activate the AutoFlow, then save an account to see the score appear instantly.

endpoints.title: Calculate Score (Asynchronous)
endpoints.summary: Responds 202 immediately so the user's save completes instantly, then calculates the score in the background and writes it back to the CRM via GET (ETag) + PATCH (If-Match). Includes a switchable processing delay to illustrate slow operations.
endpoints.responseNote: 202 Accepted with { accepted: true, message: "Processing in background" }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open Settings → Extensibility → AutoFlows.
Create a new AutoFlow on the Account business object.
Set the trigger to "On Save" and the type to Asynchronous.
Add an action of type "Call External Service / Webhook".
Paste this endpoint's full URL (shown above) as the target.
Map the account record as the request body (currentImage).
Make sure the API user (CRM_USERNAME) has write access so the background PATCH succeeds.
Activate the AutoFlow. Use the delay toggle above to compare instant vs. 10-second processing.

endpoints.title: Create Urgent Opportunity Task
endpoints.summary: When an opportunity's priority changes to Urgent, creates a follow-up task linked to the opportunity, assigned to its owner and due in 3 days. Uses beforeImage vs currentImage so it only fires on an actual change.
endpoints.responseNote: 202 Accepted with { accepted: true, message: "Processing in background" }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open Settings → Extensibility → AutoFlows.
Create a new AutoFlow on the Opportunity business object.
Set the trigger to "On Save" and the type to Asynchronous.
Add an action of type "Call External Service / Webhook".
Paste this endpoint's full URL (shown above) as the target.
Map both beforeImage and currentImage into the request body so the change guard works.
Confirm the priority code for "Urgent" matches PRIORITY_URGENT ("2") in server.js.
Activate the AutoFlow, then change an opportunity's priority to Urgent and save.

endpoints.title: External Alerts
endpoints.summary: Not an AutoFlow — a UI Extension data provider. SSC V2 calls this on demand while rendering the Account page to display external alert signals (risk flags, compliance warnings). Replace the sample alerts with a real data source.
endpoints.responseNote: 200 OK with { count, alerts: [{ signalType, icon, color, groupText, message }] }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open Settings → Extensibility → UI Extensions (or External Alerts configuration).
Create a new External Alerts / signal provider for the Account object.
Register this endpoint's full URL (shown above) as the data provider.
Open any account page — the alerts returned here render in the alerts area.
Edit the alerts array in server.js to connect your real alert source.

endpoints.title: Account Insights Chart
endpoints.summary: Not an AutoFlow — a UI Extension data provider. SSC V2 calls this when rendering a custom chart widget in the Account Insights panel. Returns chart data; replace the hardcoded values with a real data source.
endpoints.responseNote: 200 OK with { total, data: [{ name, y }] }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open Settings → Extensibility → UI Extensions.
Add a custom chart widget to the Account Insights panel.
Register this endpoint's full URL (shown above) as the chart data provider.
Open any account page to see the chart render with the data below.
Edit the data array in server.js to feed the chart from your real source.
